description.zh: 集群系列。取值：Normal（集群版）、Basic（单节点）、ArchiveNormal（归档版）、SENormal（标准版）、NormalMultimaster（多主集群）
description.en:
The cluster edition. Valid values:
- Normal: Cluster Edition.
- Basic: Single Node Edition.
- ArchiveNormal: Archive Database.
- SENormal: Standard Edition.
- NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster.

description.zh: 集群ID。非BUY场景必填
description.en: The cluster ID. Required for non-BUY scenarios.

description.zh: 节点规格。BUY场景必填，格式如polar.mysql.x4.large
description.en: The node specifications. Required for the BUY scenario. Example format: polar.mysql.x4.large.

description.zh: 待删除节点ID列表。ModifyType为DELETE时使用
description.en: The list of node IDs to delete. Used when ModifyType is set to DELETE.

description.zh: 节点数量。BUY场景有效，包含读写节点，最小值为1，默认为1
description.en: The number of nodes. Valid for the BUY scenario. This value includes the read/write node. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 异构变配节点列表。变配场景使用，指定各节点的目标规格
description.en: The list of heterogeneous specification change nodes. Used for specification change scenarios to specify the target specifications for each node.

description.zh: 目标节点规格
description.en: The target node specifications.

description.zh: 节点ID
description.en: The node ID.

description.zh: 数据库引擎类型。BUY场景必填，取值：MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle
description.en: The database engine type. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.

description.zh: 数据库引擎版本。BUY场景必填。MySQL取值：5.6、5.7、8.0；PostgreSQL取值：11、14；Oracle取值：11、14
description.en: The database engine version. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values for MySQL: 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0. Valid values for PostgreSQL: 11 and 14. Valid values for Oracle: 11 and 14.

description.zh: 是否开启热备集群。取值：ON（开启）、OFF（关闭）。BUY场景和变更场景有效
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:
- ON: Enable.
- OFF: Disable.

Valid for the BUY and specification change scenarios.

description.zh: 变配方向。取值：ADD（增加节点）、DELETE（删除节点）、UPGRADE（升配）、DOWNGRADE（降配）、HOT_STANDBY（热备变更）、STORAGE（存储空间变配）、STORAGE_TYPE（存储类型变配）
description.en:
The specification change direction. Valid values:
- ADD: add nodes.
- DELETE: remove nodes.
- UPGRADE: upgrade specifications.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications.
- HOT_STANDBY: hot standby change.
- STORAGE: storage space change.
- STORAGE_TYPE: storage type change.

description.zh: 订单类型。取值：BUY（新购）、CONVERT（付费类型转换）、RENEW（续费）、UPGRADE（升配/增加节点）、DOWNGRADE（降配/删除节点）
description.en:
The order type. Valid values:
- BUY: new purchase.
- CONVERT: billing method conversion.
- RENEW: renewal.
- UPGRADE: upgrade specifications or add nodes.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications or remove nodes.

description.zh: 付费类型。BUY和CONVERT场景必填。取值：Prepaid（包年包月）、Postpaid（按量付费）
description.en:
The billing method. Required for the BUY and CONVERT scenarios. Valid values:
- Prepaid: subscription.
- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh: 购买周期。取值：Month（月）、Year（年）
description.en:
The subscription cycle. Valid values:
- Month: monthly.
- Year: yearly.

description.zh: 预配置IOPS。标准版（SENormal）场景使用
description.en: The provisioned IOPS. Used for the Standard Edition (SENormal) scenario.

description.zh: 地域ID
description.en: The region ID.

description.zh: Serverless类型。取值：AgileServerless
description.en: The serverless type. Valid values: AgileServerless.

description.zh: 存储计费类型。取值：Prepaid（预付费）、Postpaid（按量付费）
description.en:
The storage billing type. Valid values:
- Prepaid: subscription.
- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh: 存储空间，单位为GB。预付费存储或存储变配场景使用
description.en: The storage space, in GB. Used for prepaid storage or storage specification change scenarios.

description.zh: 存储类型。取值：PSL5（高性能）、PSL4（标准）、ESSDPL0、ESSDPL1、ESSDPL2、ESSDPL3、ESSDAUTOPL
description.en:
The storage type. Valid values:
- PSL5: high performance.
- PSL4: standard.
- ESSDPL0
- ESSDPL1
- ESSDPL2
- ESSDPL3
- ESSDAUTOPL

description.zh: 购买时长。与Period配合使用，BUY/CONVERT/RENEW场景且付费类型为Prepaid时有效
description.en: The subscription duration. Used together with Period. Valid for the BUY, CONVERT, and RENEW scenarios when the billing method is Prepaid.

description.zh: 可用区ID。BUY场景建议传入
description.en: The zone ID. We recommend that you specify this parameter for the BUY scenario.
